task: Get the report from the final environmental impact statement for the Jamaica Bus Depot expansion on new.mta.info.
agent_final_answer: The report from the Final Environmental Impact Statement (FEIS) for the Jamaica Bus Depot Expansion is "Volume 2: FEIS Report." It was reached via the MTA project page (mta.info/project/jamaica-bus-depot-expansion) under the "Documents" section, in the "Final Environmental Impact Statement" accordion, which lists three volumes: Volume 1 (Executive Summary), Volume 2 (FEIS Report), and Volume 3 (Appendices). The report opens as a 371-page PDF at https://www.mta.info/document/10341, titled "Final Environmental Impact Statement - Volume 2: FEIS Report - For the Proposed Reconstruction and Expansion of Jamaica Bus Depot, Jamaica, Queens, New York, September 2019," prepared for MTA New York City Transit. The FEIS was completed and accepted by MTA NYCT in September 2019.
